questions.stem: Explain why robust monitoring is essential for Continuous Deployment.
markingGuide: Robust monitoring helps detect issues in real-time.
It allows for quick identification and resolution of problems.
Monitoring ensures that deployments do not negatively impact users.
questions.explanation: Robust monitoring is crucial because it allows teams to detect issues as they occur, enabling quick response and minimizing the impact on users. Without monitoring, problems could go unnoticed, leading to poor user experience.

questions.stem: Discuss the importance of a rollback mechanism in Continuous Deployment.
markingGuide: A rollback mechanism allows reverting changes if issues occur.
It minimizes downtime and impact on users.
Ensures stability and reliability of the production environment.
questions.explanation: A rollback mechanism is important because it provides a way to quickly revert deployments if issues arise, minimizing downtime and ensuring the stability of the production environment. This is crucial for maintaining user trust and system reliability.
